dedupe_keys.name: national water commission jamaica weekly dam and reservoir levels mona reservoir and hermitage dam

description: Jamaica's National Water Commission publishes weekly storage readings for the two main sources of the Corporate Area supply: Mona Reservoir (capacity 808.5 million gallons, 3,675 ML) and Hermitage Dam (capacity 393.5 million gallons, 1,789 ML). Each reading gives the stored volume in million gallons, the percentage of full capacity, the date and the trend against the last reading, with status bands (good at 70 percent and above). On 27 September 2026 the page showed readings as of 25 September 2026. Coverage is the Kingston and St. Andrew supply system. Access is online and free on the NWC website. Caveats: only the latest reading is shown on the page, so a series must be collected over time; the page explains that falling levels can lead to lock-off schedules published as advisories. Simulation uses: reservoir state for drought and supply-restriction scenarios in water supply models of Kingston. Related records: Hong Kong reservoir open data (data-hong-kong-wsd-open-data-reservoirs-supply-bursts) and PAGASA dam levels (data-pagasa-dam-water-level-updates).
